items.name: Alzheimer’s Disease
items.description: Alzheimer’s Disease is a neurodegenerative disorder in which abnormal protein buildup damages brain cells, leading to progressive memory loss and cognitive decline.

items.name: Arthritis
items.description: Arthritis is a general term for conditions that cause joint pain, swelling, stiffness, and reduced range of motion, often due to inflammation or joint damage.

items.name: Celiac Disease
items.description: Celiac Disease is an autoimmune disorder in which ingestion of gluten triggers immune damage to the small intestine, impairing nutrient absorption and causing gastrointestinal symptoms.

items.name: Chronic Inflammatory Response Syndrome (CIRS)
items.description: Chronic Inflammatory Response Syndrome (CIRS) is an emerging condition characterized by persistent inflammation following exposure to biotoxins like mold.

items.name: Crohn’s Disease
items.description: Crohn’s Disease is a chronic autoimmune condition that causes inflammation anywhere along the gastrointestinal tract, leading to abdominal pain, diarrhea, and malabsorption.

items.name: Diabetes (Type 2)
items.description: Diabetes (Type 2) is a metabolic disorder characterized by insulin resistance and eventual insulin deficiency, leading to elevated blood sugar.

items.name: Diverticulitis
items.description: Diverticulitis is a condition in which small pouches in the colon wall become inflamed or infected, causing abdominal pain and digestive symptoms.

items.name: Eczema
items.description: Eczema is a chronic inflammatory skin condition in which the skin barrier becomes impaired, leading to dry, itchy, and inflamed patches.

items.name: Endometriosis
items.description: Endometriosis is a chronic condition where tissue similar to the lining of the uterus grows outside the uterus, causing inflammation and pain.

items.name: Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD)
items.description: Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) is a condition in which excess fat accumulates in liver cells, often leading to inflammation and liver damage.

items.name: Galactosemia
items.description: Galactosemia is a rare genetic disorder in which the body is unable to metabolize galactose, a sugar found in milk, leading to toxic buildup.

items.name: GLP-1 Support
items.description: GLP‑1 receptor agonists reduce appetite and can slow stomach emptying. These dietary adjustments help manage side effects and support weight loss.

items.name: Gout
items.description: Gout is a form of inflammatory arthritis in which uric acid crystals accumulate in joints, causing sudden, severe pain and swelling.

items.name: Graves’ Disease
items.description: Graves’ Disease is an autoimmune condition in which the immune system stimulates the thyroid gland to produce excess hormones.

items.name: Hashimoto’s Thyroiditis
items.description: Hashimoto’s Thyroiditis is an autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks the thyroid gland, leading to hypothyroidism.

items.name: Heart Disease
items.description: Heart Disease involves plaque buildup in arteries that can lead to heart attacks or heart failure.

items.name: High Cholesterol
items.description: High cholesterol involves elevated levels of LDL or 'bad' cholesterol in the blood, which contributes to plaque buildup in the arteries.

items.name: Histamine Intolerance
items.description: Histamine Intolerance is a condition in which the body cannot efficiently break down histamine, leading to headaches, rashes, and digestive issues.

items.name: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD)
items.description: IBD is a group of autoimmune conditions, including Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis, where chronic inflammation damages the GI tract.

items.name: Insulin Resistance
items.description: Insulin resistance is a metabolic condition in which cells become less responsive to insulin, leading to elevated blood sugar and increased risk of type 2 diabetes.

items.name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)
items.description: IBS is a functional gastrointestinal disorder characterized by abdominal pain, bloating, and altered bowel habits without underlying tissue damage.

items.name: Lupus (Systemic Lupus Erythematosus)
items.description: Lupus is a systemic autoimmune disease in which the immune system attacks healthy tissues, causing inflammation and organ damage throughout the body.

items.name: Mast Cell Activation Syndrome (MCAS)
items.description: MCAS is a condition in which mast cells release excessive inflammatory mediators, leading to symptoms such as hives, flushing, and anaphylaxis-like reactions.

items.name: Metabolic Syndrome
items.description: Metabolic Syndrome is a cluster of abnormalities—including high blood pressure and blood sugar—that increase the risk of heart disease and diabetes.

items.name: Non-Celiac Gluten Sensitivity
items.description: A condition where individuals experience symptoms similar to celiac disease when consuming gluten, without autoimmune or allergic markers.

items.name: Obesity (Weight Loss)
items.description: Effective management focuses on sustainable lifestyle changes to reduce body fat while preserving lean muscle mass.

items.name: Osteoarthritis
items.description: A degenerative joint disease where cartilage wears down over time, leading to pain, stiffness, and reduced mobility.

items.name: Osteoporosis
items.description: A condition in which bones become weak and brittle due to loss of bone density, increasing fracture risk.

items.name: Psoriasis
items.description: A chronic autoimmune skin condition leading to thick, scaly patches and systemic inflammation.

items.name: Psoriatic Arthritis
items.description: Psoriatic Arthritis is an inflammatory arthritis associated with psoriasis, where the immune system attacks joints and connective tissue.

items.name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
items.description: An autoimmune condition in which the immune system attacks the joints, leading to chronic inflammation and joint deformity.

items.name: Small Intestinal Bacterial Overgrowth (SIBO)
items.description: A condition where excessive bacteria grow in the small intestine, leading to gas, bloating, and malabsorption.

items.name: Stroke
items.description: A medical emergency in which blood flow to the brain is interrupted, causing potential neurological deficits.

items.name: Thyroid Cancer
items.description: A malignancy of the thyroid gland that can disrupt hormone production.

items.name: Ulcerative Colitis
items.description: A form of IBD where the immune system causes chronic inflammation and ulcers in the colon lining.
